name: Remulos
summary: In Moonglade, Keeper Remulos guides the druids of the Cenarion Circle. Cenarius has fallen and Malfurion Stormrage sleeps, so Remulos helps lead the Circle. He puts nature’s balance before night elven isolation.

sections.title: Lord of the Sacred Grove
sections.body: Keeper Remulos watches over Moonglade, the druids’ sacred sanctuary north of Mount Hyjal. Immortal, he bears the lower body of a great stag and the antlered torso of an ancient dryad-father. His divine authority and counsel aid the Cenarion Circle while Malfurion Stormrage remains trapped in the Emerald Dream. He works to heal Azeroth’s scars and aids druids in their sacred rites around Lake Elune'ara.

sections.title: A Rift in the Circle
sections.body:
Keeper Remulos often clashes with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm over the Circle’s path. Staghelm champions night elven supremacy and sought to restore his people’s lost immortality by planting Teldrassil. Remulos opposed the new World Tree, seeing its planting as hubris.

Remulos also defied Staghelm’s isolationist faction by welcoming Hamuul Runetotem and the tauren into the Cenarion Circle. There, their shamans-turned-druids could learn nature’s closely guarded mysteries and help restore the land alongside others.

faq.answer: Keeper Remulos is an immortal son of Cenarius and brother to the fallen Zaetar. He lives in the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade, guards the grove, and is a senior leader of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Why does Remulos support the tauren druids?
faq.answer: Remulos believes nature’s balance reaches beyond mortal racial divides. He recognized the tauren’s deep bond with the Earth Mother and welcomed Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and his people into the Cenarion Circle despite Archdruid Fandral Staghelm’s objections.

faq.q: What is Remulos's opinion on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Remulos vehemently opposed the creation of Teldrassil. He saw the planting of the new World Tree as a selfish attempt by night elves to reclaim their lost immortality, not a true effort to heal Azeroth.

faq.q: What relation does Remulos have to Maraudon?
faq.answer: Remulos’s brother Zaetar ventured into Desolace and mated with Princess Theradras, becoming the father of the centaur before his death. Remulos warned Zaetar against the union, and Maraudon holds his brother’s legacy and that of the centaur.

angles.text: Whether night elf or tauren, every druid journeys to Moonglade to meet Keeper Remulos and seek guidance in mastering animal forms and sacred trials.
As a tauren druid, you can revere Remulos for defying Fandral Staghelm and welcoming your people into the Cenarion Circle, where they received full teaching.
